notes: Raw CODE lengths exclude up to three compiler alignment bytes; allocated lengths include them.
Most units have an 8-byte initialization stub and a preceding finalization wrapper even when source initialization/finalization sections are empty.
The initialization-table sequence is different from code order. Cached/source compilation state can affect initialization-table ordering independently.
All application form VMTS and published method entrypoints lie inside the inferred owning-unit spans.
The PACKAGEINFO unit sequence is not the CODE order and cannot by itself identify exact source uses order.
Reference trailing initializer data lengths are validated by normalized matching for all nontrivial RTL/VCL tails; empty init/fini stubs are resolved by neighboring identified units and code order.
